requirements.title: aflib dependency and import boundaries
requirements.rationale: issuex must enter hub the way every first-party module does, without leaking cgo dependencies into the CGO_ENABLED=0 afc binary.

criteria.action: require github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib v0.0.0 in go.mod with a replace directive to ../aflib, copy an aflib build context in containers/hub/Containerfile, pass --build-context aflib=../aflib in make build-hub-container, and clone aflib next to the repository in the hub and afc build workflows
criteria.contract: go build ./... succeeds with ../aflib present as a sibling checkout

setup: a sibling ../aflib checkout
check.pseudocode: mod = read('go.mod'); assert 'github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib => ../aflib' in mod; assert 'aflib=../aflib' in read('Makefile'); assert exec('go build ./...').exit == 0

criteria.action: limit direct imports of github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib/issuex to packages under internal/forge
criteria.contract: go list -deps reports issuex imported by no package outside internal/forge

setup: the hub module with internal/forge present
check.pseudocode: for pkg in go_list('./...'): if 'aflib/issuex' in pkg.Imports: assert pkg.ImportPath.startswith('.../internal/forge')

criteria.action: keep internal/forge out of the transitive imports of internal/cli and cmd/afc so that afc still builds with CGO_ENABLED=0
criteria.contract: go list -deps ./cmd/afc contains no internal/forge path and CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./cmd/afc exits 0

setup: the hub module
check.pseudocode: deps = exec('go list -deps ./cmd/afc'); assert 'internal/forge' not in deps; assert exec('CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /tmp/afc ./cmd/afc').exit == 0

requirements.title: Forge scopes and authorization order
requirements.rationale: Forge access is a new capability that PATs must be granted explicitly, and the check order must match the sandbox and merge handlers.

criteria.action: expose forge.Permissions() returning the scopes forge:read and forge:write as apikit.Permission values, appended to extraPerms in cmd/af-hub/main.go at every start
criteria.contract: forge.Permissions() returns exactly [{forge read} {forge write}]

check.pseudocode: assert forge.Permissions() == [Permission('forge','read'), Permission('forge','write')]

criteria.condition: a request to any forge route carries no credential
criteria.action: reject the request before any workspace lookup or forge call
criteria.contract: HTTP 401 error envelope

setup: forge routes mounted with no auth info injected
a forge stub that records requests
check.pseudocode: for route in ROUTES: r = get(route); assert r.status == 401; assert stub.count == 0

criteria.condition: a PAT holding neither forge:read nor forge:write calls any forge route
criteria.action: reject the request before the workspace lookup with a message naming the forge:read scope
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 error envelope whose message contains "forge:read", also for a slug that does not exist

setup: a PAT whose permissions contain only sandboxes:read
one existing and one non-existent workspace slug
check.pseudocode: for route in ROUTES: for slug in [existing, missing]: r = get(route, pat); assert r.status == 403 and 'forge:read' in r.message

criteria.condition: a PAT holding forge:write but not forge:read, an api_key or an admin_token calls a forge read route on a workspace it may access
criteria.action: pass the scope check and continue to the workspace lookup
criteria.contract: the response status is not 401 or 403

setup: an owned workspace with a stub forge answering 200
credentials: PAT with only forge:write, api_key, admin_token
check.pseudocode: for cred in [pat_write, api_key, admin]: r = get(path, cred); assert r.status not in (401,403)

criteria.condition: the credential type in apikit.AuthInfo is not admin_token, api_key or pat
criteria.action: deny the scope check
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 error envelope; no forge request is sent

setup: AuthInfo with CredentialType "mystery" and forge:read permissions
check.pseudocode: r = get(path, auth(type='mystery', perms=['forge:read'])); assert r.status == 403; assert stub.count == 0

criteria.condition: wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace reports the workspace missing or not owned by the caller
criteria.action: reject the request without resolving credentials or contacting the forge
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 error envelope on every forge route

setup: a workspace owned by another user and a missing slug
resolver and variable stubs that count calls
check.pseudocode: for route in ROUTES: for slug in [foreign, missing]: assert get(route).status == 404; assert resolver.calls == 0 and stub.count == 0

criteria.condition: an authorized caller calls a forge read route on a workspace whose status is archived or whose clone_status is not ready
criteria.action: serve the read without taking the workspace lock
criteria.contract: the same HTTP 200 response as for an active, cloned workspace

setup: three workspaces: active/ready, archived, active with clone_status pending
the workspace lock is held (rebuild active) on one of them
a TLS forge stub answering the repository
check.pseudocode: for ws in [ready, archived, pending, locked]: r = get(ws+'/forge/repository'); assert r.status == 200

requirements.title: Target selection
requirements.rationale: A carry-patch fork must be able to read its upstream repository with the credential sync already uses, and only then.

criteria.condition: a forge route other than GET /forge is called with target absent or target=origin
criteria.action: build the client from the workspace's git_url, the origin credential resolver and the FORGE_API_URL workspace variable
criteria.contract: the forge stub receives requests for the repository parsed from git_url

setup: a workspace with git_url https://github.com/acme/widgets and FORGE_API_URL pointing to a TLS stub
origin resolver returning GIT_PAT
check.pseudocode: for q in ['', '?target=origin']: assert get(path+q).status == 200; assert stub.last.path.contains('acme/widgets'); assert upstreamResolver.calls == 0

criteria.condition: a forge route other than GET /forge is called with target=upstream and the workspace_mode is carry_patch and upstream_url is non-empty
criteria.action: build the client from upstream_url, the upstream credential resolver (ResolveUpstreamAuthMethod chain) and the UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL variable, never falling back to FORGE_API_URL
criteria.contract: the forge stub receives requests for the repository parsed from upstream_url carrying the upstream credential

setup: a carry_patch workspace whose upstream_url is a different repo and host
UPSTREAM_GIT_PAT differs from GIT_PAT
FORGE_API_URL points to stub A, UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL to stub B
a second carry_patch workspace with FORGE_API_URL set but no UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL on an unclassifiable upstream host
check.pseudocode: assert get('/pulls/1/state?target=upstream').status == 200; assert B.last.token == UP_PAT; assert A.count == 0; assert get2(...).status == 422

criteria.condition: target=upstream is requested on a workspace whose workspace_mode is standard or NULL, or whose upstream_url is NULL or empty
criteria.action: reject the request without contacting the forge
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with error_type workspace_mode_mismatch; the forge stub receives no request

setup: workspaces: standard, NULL workspace_mode, carry_patch with NULL upstream_url, carry_patch with empty upstream_url
check.pseudocode: for ws in cases: r = get(ws, '?target=upstream'); assert r.status == 400 and r.error_type == 'workspace_mode_mismatch'; assert stub.count == 0

criteria.condition: target has a value other than origin or upstream, including an empty string
criteria.action: reject the request without contacting the forge
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 whose message lists the allowed values origin and upstream

setup: an owned workspace
check.pseudocode: for t in ['bogus','','ORIGIN']: r = get('?target='+t); assert r.status == 400 and 'origin' in r.msg and 'upstream' in r.msg

requirements.title: Forge client construction
requirements.rationale: Hub must act only with what it holds for the workspace, so the request can choose the target and nothing else.

criteria.action: build a fresh issuex client for every forge request and cache no client or response, so a rotated secret or changed variable applies to the next call
criteria.contract: two consecutive calls separated by a GIT_PAT change send the old and then the new token to the forge stub

setup: real secrets store with GIT_PAT=old
TLS forge stub recording the token
check.pseudocode: get(p); store.update('GIT_PAT','new'); get(p); assert stub.tokens == ['old','new']

criteria.condition: issuex cannot parse a repository from the selected remote URL
criteria.action: stop before any forge request and name the remote URL with its userinfo removed
criteria.contract: HTTP 422 with error_type forge_unknown; the message contains no userinfo

setup: a workspace whose git_url is https://user:s3cret@host with no repository path
check.pseudocode: r = get(path); assert r.status == 422 and r.error_type == 'forge_unknown'; assert 's3cret' not in r.msg and '@' not in r.msg

criteria.condition: FORGE_API_URL (for origin) or UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL (for upstream) is set to a value that is not an absolute https:// URL with a host and without userinfo, query or fragment
criteria.action: stop before any forge request with a message naming the variable and the rule but not the value
criteria.contract: HTTP 422 with error_type forge_api_url_invalid; the message does not contain the variable's value

setup: values: http://x.example, relative/path, https://u:p@h.example, https://h.example/?q=1, https://h.example/#f, https:///nohost
check.pseudocode: for v in BAD: set_var(NAME, v); r = get(); assert r.status == 422 and NAME in r.msg and v not in r.msg

criteria.condition: issuex returns ErrAmbiguousForge because the host cannot be classified and no API URL variable is set
criteria.action: stop before any request leaves hub with a message naming the host and the variable to set (FORGE_API_URL or UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL)
criteria.contract: HTTP 422 with error_type forge_unknown; no outbound request is made

setup: git_url https://git.internal.example/acme/widgets, no FORGE_API_URL
a carry_patch workspace with an unclassifiable upstream host and no UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL
a counting RoundTripper as the base transport
check.pseudocode: r = get(); assert r.status == 422 and 'FORGE_API_URL' in r.msg and transport.count == 0

criteria.action: derive the credential kind from the injected resolver result: pat when the basic-auth username is x-token-auth, basic for any other username with the password sent as the token, none for a nil result with an unauthenticated client
criteria.contract: the forge stub receives the GIT_PAT or GIT_PASSWORD value as the token for pat or basic, and no token header for none

setup: resolver results: BasicAuth{x-token-auth, tok-pat}, BasicAuth{alice, tok-pass}, nil
a fake issuex factory capturing Options.Token
check.pseudocode: for (auth, want) in cases: get(); assert captured.Token == want

criteria.condition: the credential resolver or the variable lookup returns an error other than secrets.NotFoundError
criteria.action: stop before any forge request and log the failure without any secret value
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 error envelope; no log line contains a secret value

setup: a resolver returning an error containing the text of a secret
a variable lookup returning a non-NotFound error
a captured log
check.pseudocode: for mode in [resolver_err, var_err]: r = get(); assert r.status == 500; assert 'SECRET' not in log.text

criteria.action: for any incoming request, forward neither its Authorization header nor its body to the forge
criteria.contract: the forge stub never observes the caller's bearer token

setup: a TLS forge stub recording headers and bodies of every request
check.pseudocode: for bearer, body in gen(): get(path, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer '+bearer}, body=body); for req in stub.requests: assert bearer not in str(req.headers) and body not in req.body

requirements.title: Shared HTTP client behaviour
requirements.rationale: Forge calls must reach the same hosts as git does, identify hub, never leak a token across hosts and never hang a handler.

criteria.action: use one http.Client per process whose base transport is a clone of http.DefaultTransport (honouring the environment's proxy settings) unless Config.Transport replaces it
criteria.contract: requests go through Config.Transport when it is set

setup: Config.Transport is a counting RoundTripper returning canned responses
check.pseudocode: cfg.Transport = counting; get(path); assert counting.count >= 1

criteria.action: set the User-Agent header to af-hub/<apikit.Version> on every outbound forge request through a round-tripper
criteria.contract: every request recorded by the forge stub carries User-Agent af-hub/<apikit.Version>

setup: apikit.Version set to 1.2.3 in the test
a TLS forge stub recording headers; a route that makes several upstream calls (GET /issues/:n)
check.pseudocode: apikit.Version='1.2.3'; get('/issues/1'); for r in stub.requests: assert r.UA == 'af-hub/1.2.3'

criteria.condition: the forge answers with a redirect to a host different from the one the request was sent to
criteria.action: refuse to follow the redirect so no request, and no token, reaches the other host
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with error_type forge_error; the redirect target receives no request

setup: forge stub A answering 302 with Location pointing to stub B on a different host
stub B recording requests
check.pseudocode: r = get(path); assert r.status == 502 and r.error_type == 'forge_error'; assert B.count == 0

criteria.condition: a forge call, including issuex's own retries, has not completed within 30 seconds of the deadline derived from the request context
criteria.action: cancel the outbound call
criteria.contract: HTTP 504 with error_type forge_timeout

setup: the call deadline is shortened to 50ms through the package's test hook
a forge stub that sleeps longer than the deadline
check.pseudocode: setDeadline(50ms); r = get(path); assert r.status == 504 and r.error_type == 'forge_timeout'; assert defaultDeadline == 30s

requirements.title: GET /workspaces/:slug/forge diagnostic
requirements.rationale: A person debugging forge_unknown needs to see what hub would use without hub contacting the forge.

criteria.condition: an authorized caller sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/forge
criteria.action: report the forge kind, API URL, repository and credential kind for origin without sending any request to the forge
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body {forge: github|gitlab|unknown, api_url: string|null, repository: {host, owner, name}|null, credential: pat|basic|none, upstream: object|null}; the forge stub receives no request

setup: git_url https://github.com/acme/widgets, GIT_PAT set, standard workspace
a counting forge transport
check.pseudocode: r = get('/forge'); assert r.json == {...}; assert transport.count == 0

criteria.action: report the repository owner as the full namespace path, keeping GitLab subgroups
criteria.contract: a git_url of https://gitlab.example.com/group/subgroup/widgets yields owner group/subgroup and name widgets

setup: git_url https://gitlab.example.com/group/subgroup/widgets with FORGE_API_URL https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4
check.pseudocode: r = get('/forge'); assert r.repository.owner == 'group/subgroup' and r.repository.name == 'widgets'

criteria.condition: the remote host cannot be classified, or no repository can be parsed from the remote URL
criteria.action: report forge unknown with api_url null, and repository null when unparseable, instead of failing
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with forge "unknown" and api_url null

setup: workspace A with git_url on an unclassifiable host and no FORGE_API_URL
workspace B with an unparseable git_url
check.pseudocode: a = get(A); assert a.status == 200 and a.forge == 'unknown' and a.api_url is None; b = get(B); assert b.repository is None

criteria.condition: GET /forge is called and the workspace is carry_patch with a non-empty upstream_url
criteria.action: fill the upstream block with the same four fields computed from upstream_url, the upstream resolver and UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL
criteria.contract: upstream is an object on a carry_patch workspace and null on a standard workspace

setup: a carry_patch workspace with upstream_url https://github.com/up/widgets and UPSTREAM_GIT_PAT
a standard workspace
check.pseudocode: assert get(cp).upstream.repository.owner == 'up'; assert get(std).upstream is None

criteria.condition: FORGE_API_URL, or UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL for the upstream block, is invalid when GET /forge is called
criteria.action: reject the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 422 with error_type forge_api_url_invalid

setup: FORGE_API_URL=http://insecure on one workspace
UPSTREAM_FORGE_API_URL=ftp://x on a carry_patch workspace with a valid FORGE_API_URL
check.pseudocode: for ws in cases: r = get(ws+'/forge'); assert r.status == 422 and r.error_type == 'forge_api_url_invalid'

criteria.action: for any stored credential, include only its kind in the GET /forge response and never a secret value
criteria.contract: the response body contains neither the token nor the password

setup: a workspace whose resolver returns arbitrary credentials
check.pseudocode: for tok, user, pw in gen(): body = get('/forge').text; assert tok not in body and pw not in body; assert json(body).credential in ('pat','basic','none')

requirements.title: Read routes
requirements.rationale: Callers read repository, issues, comments and pull requests in the shapes issuex defines, with bad parameters failing in hub rather than at the forge.

criteria.condition: an authorized caller sends GET on /forge/repository, /issues, /issues/:n, /issues/:n/comments, /pulls/:n, /pulls/:n/state, /pulls/:n/files, /pulls/:n/checks or /pulls/:n/reviews under /api/v1/workspaces/:slug
criteria.action: call respectively GetRepository, ListIssues, ReadIssue, ListComments, ReadPullRequest, GetPRState, ReadChangedFiles, GetCIChecks or GetPRReviews and encode the issuex result unchanged
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the JSON encoding of the issuex result type; GET /issues/:n includes the comments and issuex's truncation flag

setup: a TLS stub serving minimal GitHub JSON for repository, issues, one issue with comments, comments, pull request, state, files, checks and reviews
real issuex client
check.pseudocode: for (route, method) in TABLE: assert get(route).json == json(issuex_direct(method))

criteria.action: encode every list result as a bare JSON array and an empty list as []
criteria.contract: an empty list response body is [] and never null

setup: a fake issuex client returning nil slices for ListIssues, ListComments, ReadChangedFiles, GetCIChecks and GetPRReviews
check.pseudocode: for route in LIST_ROUTES: assert get(route).body.strip() == '[]'

criteria.condition: the :n path parameter is not a positive decimal integer (for example 0, -1, 1.5, abc)
criteria.action: reject the request before building a client
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 whose message names the parameter; the forge stub receives no request

setup: a factory and a forge stub that count calls
check.pseudocode: for route in N_ROUTES: for n in ['0','-1','1.5','abc']: r = get(route % n); assert r.status == 400 and 'n' in r.msg; assert factory.calls == 0

criteria.condition: on GET /issues, state is not open|closed|all, sort is not created|updated, direction is not asc|desc, or limit is not an integer from 1 to 100
criteria.action: reject the request before building a client
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 whose message names the offending parameter; the forge stub receives no request

setup: a factory and a forge stub that count calls
check.pseudocode: for q in BAD: r = get('/issues?'+q); assert r.status == 400 and param(q) in r.msg; assert factory.calls == 0

criteria.condition: GET /issues is called with valid query parameters
criteria.action: split labels on commas dropping empty items, pass assignee as free text, omit every absent parameter from the issuex call, and always pass limit, defaulting to 30
criteria.contract: labels=af:triage,,bug reaches issuex as [af:triage bug]; no limit query yields limit 30

setup: a fake issuex client capturing ListIssues options
check.pseudocode: get('/issues?labels=af:triage,,bug&assignee=bob&state=open'); assert cap.labels == ['af:triage','bug'] and cap.limit == 30 and cap.sort == ''

criteria.action: emit no audit event for any forge read route
criteria.contract: no hub audit event is recorded for a forge read

setup: an audit store or emitter spy wired to the same DB
check.pseudocode: for route in ROUTES: get(route); assert emitter.calls == 0 and count(hub_events) == 0

requirements.title: Forge failure mapping
requirements.rationale: Every class of forge failure needs exactly one documented hub answer.

criteria.condition: the forge answers 404
criteria.action: map the failure
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with error_type forge_not_found

setup: a TLS stub answering 404 to the issue request
check.pseudocode: stub.status=404; r = get('/issues/9'); assert r.status == 404 and r.error_type == 'forge_not_found'

criteria.condition: the forge answers 401
criteria.action: map the failure and, when the credential kind is basic, append a note that the forge API needs a token stored as GIT_PAT or as GIT_PASSWORD
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with error_type forge_unauthenticated

setup: a TLS stub answering 401
one workspace with a pat credential and one with a basic credential
check.pseudocode: assert pat.status == 502 and 'GIT_PASSWORD' not in pat.msg; assert basic.status == 502 and 'GIT_PASSWORD' in basic.msg

criteria.condition: the forge answers 403 that issuex does not report as a rate limit
criteria.action: map the failure
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with error_type forge_forbidden

setup: a TLS stub answering 403 without rate-limit headers
check.pseudocode: stub.status=403; r = get('/pulls/3'); assert r.status == 502 and r.error_type == 'forge_forbidden'

criteria.condition: issuex reports a rate limit it could not wait out
criteria.action: map the failure and, when the forge gave a retry-after duration, set the Retry-After header to that duration in whole seconds rounded up
criteria.contract: HTTP 429 with error_type forge_rate_limited and Retry-After when known (1.2s yields 2)

setup: a TLS stub answering rate-limited with a retry-after of 1.2 seconds, and another with no retry-after
check.pseudocode: r = get('/issues'); assert r.status == 429 and r.header['Retry-After'] == '2'; assert 'Retry-After' not in get2('/issues').header

criteria.condition: the forge answers a 4xx status other than 401, 403 or 404
criteria.action: map the failure
criteria.contract: HTTP 422 with error_type forge_rejected

setup: a TLS stub answering 400, 410 and 422 in turn
check.pseudocode: for code in (400,410,422): stub.status=code; assert get('/issues').status == 422 and error_type == 'forge_rejected'

criteria.condition: the forge answers 5xx or a response issuex cannot read
criteria.action: map the failure
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with error_type forge_error

setup: a TLS stub answering 500, 503, and 200 with a non-JSON body
check.pseudocode: for mode in (500,503,'garbage200'): r = get('/issues/1'); assert r.status == 502 and r.error_type == 'forge_error'

criteria.condition: the connection to the forge fails at DNS, TCP or TLS level
criteria.action: map the failure
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with error_type forge_unreachable

setup: FORGE_API_URL pointing to a closed TLS listener port, and another with a TLS certificate the transport does not trust
check.pseudocode: closed.Close(); r = get('/forge/repository'); assert r.status == 502 and r.error_type == 'forge_unreachable'

requirements.title: Message scrubbing and logging
requirements.rationale: A forge message relayed to the caller or written to a log must never carry the workspace credential.

criteria.action: for any forge message placed in the error envelope, replace every occurrence of the resolved token with [redacted], remove URL userinfo, and cut the result to at most 1024 bytes on a UTF-8 boundary
criteria.contract: the message contains neither the token nor userinfo, is valid UTF-8 and is at most 1024 bytes

setup: a scrub function or a forge stub whose error message is attacker-chosen
check.pseudocode: for msg, tok in gen(): out = scrub(msg, tok); assert tok not in out and utf8valid(out) and len(out) <= 1024 and not userinfo_re.search(out)

criteria.condition: a forge route answers 5xx or 429 because of a forge failure
criteria.action: log one line with the workspace slug, the target, the operation and the forge status
criteria.contract: the log line contains no token, request body or response body

setup: a captured log
stub answering 500 with a body containing the token, and another answering 429
check.pseudocode: get('/issues'); line = log.single(); assert all(k in line for k in ['widgets','origin','ListIssues','500']); assert TOKEN not in line and BODY not in line

criteria.action: for any forge route response body and any log line it writes, include neither the credential value nor URL userinfo
criteria.contract: captured responses and logs across all error classes contain no secret value or user:pass@ sequence

setup: a token and a git_url carrying userinfo
a stub that returns each failure class with the token and user:pass@host in its message
captured logs
check.pseudocode: for route, cls in product(ROUTES, CLASSES): r = get(route); assert TOKEN not in r.body and not re.search(r'://[^/\s]*:[^/\s]*@', r.body + log.text)

requirements.title: afc forge, issue and pr commands
requirements.rationale: Agents and people read forge data through afc with the same output and exit-code conventions as the rest of the CLI.

criteria.condition: a user runs afc forge status <slug>
criteria.action: send GET /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/forge and print the response as one JSON document through apikit.CLIPrintResult
criteria.contract: exit code 0 and exactly one JSON document on stdout

setup: a stub hub recording method and path and answering the diagnostic JSON
check.pseudocode: out = run('forge','status','widgets'); assert hub.path == '/api/v1/workspaces/widgets/forge' and decodeOneDocument(out)

criteria.condition: a user runs afc issue list <slug> with any of --state, --label (repeatable), --assignee, --limit and --target
criteria.action: send GET /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/issues with each set flag as a query parameter, repeated --label values joined with commas, unset flags omitted, and values passed as given
criteria.contract: --label a --label b yields labels=a,b; no flags yields no query string; one JSON document on stdout

setup: a stub hub recording the raw query
check.pseudocode: run('issue','list','widgets','--label','a','--label','b'); assert hub.query['labels'] == 'a,b'; run('issue','list','widgets'); assert hub.rawquery == ''

criteria.condition: a user runs afc issue get <slug> <n> or afc pr get|state|files|checks|reviews <slug> <n>, optionally with --target
criteria.action: send GET to /issues/<n>, /pulls/<n>, /pulls/<n>/state, /pulls/<n>/files, /pulls/<n>/checks or /pulls/<n>/reviews under the workspace, with segments escaped by apiPath and target added only when set
criteria.contract: one JSON document on stdout and exit code 0 on HTTP 200

setup: a stub hub recording the path and query
check.pseudocode: for cmd, suffix in TABLE: run(cmd,'w','42'); assert hub.path == '/api/v1/workspaces/w'+suffix and hub.query == ''

criteria.condition: hub answers a forge, issue or pr command with an error status
criteria.action: return the error through apikit.CLIHandleError
criteria.contract: the non-zero exit code apikit assigns to that status

setup: a stub hub answering 404, 422 and 429 error envelopes
check.pseudocode: for status in (404,422,429): res = run(...); assert res.exit == apikit.CLIExitCode(status)

criteria.condition: a forge, issue or pr subcommand is given the wrong number of positional arguments
criteria.action: fail without sending any request to hub
criteria.contract: non-zero exit code; the stub hub records no request

setup: a stub hub recording requests
check.pseudocode: for args in BAD: assert run(*args).exit != 0; assert hub.count == 0

execution_paths.title: An API-key caller lists open triage issues on the workspace's origin forge

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/widgets/issues?labels=af:triage&state=open with an API key bearer token
pass the scope check, authorize the workspace with wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace and validate target and query parameters
reads git_url, resolves GIT_PAT through the origin resolver and FORGE_API_URL through GetVariable, and builds a fresh issuex client
